---
name: Propose an entry
about: Suggest a model or tool this database should cover
labels: new-entry
---

**What is it, and which category does it belong in?**

<!-- One of the category ids in data/taxonomy.yaml. If none of them fit, say so
     - a genuinely new category is a reasonable proposal. -->

**Official source URL**

<!-- The provider's own docs, pricing page or model card. An entry cannot be
     accepted on the strength of a third-party write-up alone. -->

**What can you verify from that source?**

<!-- Pricing? Context window? Licence? List what the page actually states, not
     what you believe to be true. Anything you cannot verify should be left
     out of the entry rather than filled in from memory. -->

**What is it bad at?**

<!-- Required. Every entry lists weaknesses, and the validator rejects one
     that does not. -->
